name: Clovis Steel LLC
about:
Clovis Steel LLC began in 1999 as a steel retailer in Clovis, New Mexico. Over the next two decades the company expanded into a full‑service building center with a second location in Canyon, Texas. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership structure has not been disclosed.

Today the business supplies structural and sheet steel, hardware, and a range of building products to contractors, builders, and homeowners. Its core fabrication shop produces custom metal work, including bolt‑up, cold‑formed, and weld‑up building packages, and provides free estimates, building take‑offs, and stamped drawings for concrete foundations. The company also stocks garage doors from C.H.I., LiftMaster, and Amarr; welding equipment from Miller, Lincoln, Forney, Hobart, and Victor; concrete supplies such as rebar, remesh, and Quikrete; fence materials built to ASTM standards; and plumbing, irrigation, and seasonal products. Material delivery is available for local jobs.

Customers span residential, commercial, and agricultural construction. Engineers and contractors rely on the firm for pre‑engineered building kits — the Centra Series ships in as little as two weeks — as well as for custom fabrication and a broad inventory of hardware, fence, and plumbing supplies. Agricultural clients purchase water troughs, culverts, and irrigation pipe, while residential buyers select garage doors, fencing, and seasonal equipment.

The company emphasizes bilingual (Spanish) support, a lifetime warranty on its R Lock and M Lock steel panels, and free local delivery on select items. Fast turnaround and personalized service are cited as the foundation of its reputation since its start as a small steel retailer.
